Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.
Customer experience
Customer experience at Nebius AI Cloud involves tackling customers’ challenges and directly impacting their success by solving real-world AI and ML problems at massive GPU cloud scale. You’ll not only resolve issues, but play a key role in shaping clients’ business success by optimizing their AI solutions.
Working with advanced GPUs such as H200, B200 and GB200, as well as modern ML frameworks, you’ll influence the development of the Nebius AI Cloud and gain experience at the intersection of infrastructure and AI. With minimal bureaucracy, you’ll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership and drive change. Opportunities for growth are abundant in this vibrant and supportive professional community.

We are looking for a Partner Solutions Architect to serve as the technical interface between Nebius and our strategic technology partners, ranging from data platforms and MLOps vendors to AI frameworks and ISVs that build on GPU infrastructure.
This is a hands-on engineering and integration role. You will design and develop integrated solutions, build reference implementations, enable partner engineering teams, and ensure joint customers succeed with combined offerings. You will influence Nebius’ product roadmap and drive deep technical collaboration across partner ecosystems.
You’re welcome to work from our office in Amsterdam or remotely from any EU country .

Own the technical relationship with strategic partners as the primary interface to Nebius engineering and product
Design and architect high-impact integration solutions, delivering clear joint customer value
Build and maintain reference implementations and production-grade integrations
Define enterprise-ready integration patterns (networking, security, compliance, observability)
Translate partner and customer feedback into actionable product and roadmap requirements
Enable partner teams through technical documentation, training, and demo environments
Provide technical leadership in joint customer deployments, architecture reviews, and complex troubleshooting

5+ years in solutions architecture, partner engineering, or technical pre-sales at cloud or data platform companies
Strong expertise in cloud infrastructure
Hands-on experience with GPU-accelerated AI/ML workflows (training, inference, MLOps)
Proven background in integration architecture (API design, data pipelines, security, observability)
Experience with Python and IaC tools
Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders

Consultative Problem-Solving: Exceptional active listening and analytical skills to convert high-level client business strategies into actionable Workfront architecture.

Workfront Architecture & SME: Deep technical expertise in configuring Workfront objects, custom forms, request queues, and enterprise template design.

Lifecycle Campaign Understanding: Working knowledge of upstream marketing operations, including brand strategy, campaign planning, and creative content creation lifecycles.

Workfront Fusion Mastery: Advanced proficiency in Workfront Fusion scenario architecture, API integration, data mapping, and custom webhooks.

System Integrations: Hands-on experience creating resilient multi-step automated workflows between Workfront and developer platforms like Jira.

AI/LLM Application: Familiarity with leveraging LLMs/AI models (specifically Claude) to optimize operational efficiency, automate intake processing, or auto-generate project insights.

Change Management: Strong communication skills to drive system adoption, establish governance, and guide teams through operational shifts.

4+ years of hands-on experience as a Workfront Solution Architect, Process Consultant, or Senior Systems Specialist.

Travel to customers in your region

Experience designing and architecting distributed data systems

Act as the trusted architecture counterpart for enterprise architects and technical leadership on the customer side — from first pre-sales conversations through large-scale production deployments.
Design the target solution architecture for enterprise transformations: how Taktile integrates into the customer's existing landscape of core systems, data platforms, and surrounding services, and how that architecture evolves over a multi-year journey.
Own the hardest architecture questions in our deals — integration patterns, deployment models, throughput, latency, security, compliance, data residency — and turn them from blockers into reasons to buy.

Estamos buscando um Arquiteto de Soluções para o Time Vetta!

Buscamos um profissional que atuará como principal referência de arquitetura, garantindo aderência ao HLD da solução, aos padrões tecnológicos e de DevSecOps da empresa, e assegurando que as integrações com plataformas de engenharia, BIM/ACC e sistemas corporativos de CapEx sejam robustas, seguras e escaláveis. VOCÊ JÁ CONHECE A VETTA?

Na Vetta, acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação são essenciais para criar um futuro mais sustentável e eficiente para todos.

Como uma empresa líder em digitalização industrial, nossas soluções estão ajudando clientes em todo o mundo a reduzir o consumo de energia, a melhorar a eficiência operacional e apoiar a transição energética através da descarbonização.

Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos emocionantes e desafiadores com alguns dos maiores especialistas da indústria . Além disso, você fará parte de uma equipe dedicada em gerar um impacto positivo no mundo e em ajudar nossos clientes a alcançar seus objetivos de negócios.

O Time Vetta sabe a importância do trabalho em equipe e da colaboração para alcançar resultados que atingem todo o globo – ao mesmo tempo que a carreira de cada um é transformada. Se você quer compartilhar a sua perspectiva para um mundo mais sustentável, venha ser parte do Time Vetta! 💙 Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:
Definir, evoluir e validar a arquitetura da solução (back-end e front-end desacoplados, executando em Docker Containers), garantindo aderência ao HLD e aos padrões corporativos.
Especificar e revisar as integrações do Smart CapEx PQ com plataformas de engenharia e BIM (ex.: Autodesk Construction Cloud - ACC), viabilizando a extração e validação automatizada de quantitativos a partir de modelos 3D.
Definir a arquitetura de integração com o sistema corporativo de gestão do CapEx (PPM Ecosys) e demais sistemas internos/externos.
Liderar tecnicamente desenvolvedores back-end (Java/Spring Boot/Hibernate) e front-end (Angular), promovendo boas práticas e qualidade de código.
Definir e manter a infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform em ambiente Microsoft Azure.
Estabelecer e monitorar a esteira de CI/CD, incluindo análise e aprovação de Pull Requests via gitflow, qualidade de código via SonarQube e integração com processos de mudança (ITSM).
Garantir cobertura mínima de 90% de testes unitários e aderência às práticas de DevSecOps.
Apoiar o Product Owner na priorização técnica e na viabilidade das histórias do backlog.
Conduzir a documentação técnica da solução (arquitetura, integrações, decisões e trade-offs) e sessões de transferência de conhecimento para o squad.
Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planning, daily, review, retrospectiva e refinamento).

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

s.h: BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO
s.t:
Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.
Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.
Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

Shape a first-of-a-kind machine: Alpha will be the first stellarator to achieve net energy, requiring a deeply coupled design where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating all work as one system, each pushed to the edge of what it can deliver alone.
Own the coherence of the design: As part of the integrated design team, you'll turn fast-moving engineering feedback into architecture decisions that improve performance, margin, and cost.
Be accountable for the outcome: You'll be responsible for whether Alpha's concept resolves into an elegant and efficient design.

Hold the whole machine in view. Keep Alpha converging on its top-level mission requirements while detailed decisions land at a fast pace.
Close the loop between architecture and engineering. Address feedback from the subsystem teams and detailed engineering design, and fold it back into the machine architecture fast, and with judgment about what actually moves the needle.
Hunt the uncertainties that drive the design. Identify the large model uncertainties baked into our design process, quantify them, and decide where to spend margin and where to reclaim it.
Find the levers. Use first-principles estimates and reduced models to locate the changes that cut cost or unlock performance, then scope them alongside the teams who'll build them.

You've earned your judgment on complex machines. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have years of experience in industries where integration challenges are at the heart of the design, such as aerospace, semiconductors, or Formula 1.
Your view goes across physics. You're as comfortable reasoning about Lorentz forces on a coil as about microwave-plasma coupling, and you know when a back-of-envelope calculation beats a week of simulation.

Christopher Kraft has accompanied numerous IWM transitions as an investment banker at Perella Weinberg Partners and in leading European wealth platforms. Felix Lobkowicz is a repeat founder — five companies, one IPO — and leads product and technology at Thrivo.

Finn Weise leads capital and governance with over a decade of experience building fintechs and financial platforms, previously at Morgan Stanley and European VC funds. On the board: Sebastian Henrichs, former CEO of FNZ Bank Germany — the leading wealth platform in the industry.
Behind Thrivo
Thrivo is backed by a circle of investors from the finance and fintech world — experienced operators, entrepreneurs, and family offices who understand this market and think long-term. A platform that promises long-term thinking to founders cannot itself be optimising for short-term returns.
The wealth management market in Germany and Switzerland is digitising — more slowly than other sectors, but with real momentum now. Thrivo is building the technology infrastructure that underpins this transformation: a platform for founder-led wealth managers that deploys compliance automation, AI-assisted processes, and modern data architecture in a way that until now has only been available to large institutions.
ThrivoOS is not another fintech dashboard. It is the operating system for a growing group of partner firms collectively managing several billion AUM. You build this — as the first technical full-time hire and the engineering lead.

You own the technical leadership of ThrivoOS. You set the architecture, coordinate the freelance senior engineer, and are the engineering constant in a project that bridges complex regulatory requirements — MiFID II, WpHG, BaFin — with modern AI infrastructure.
You work directly with Felix Lobkowicz (CTO-in-function) on product vision and technical direction. The most important architectural decisions are yours. The architecture and stack have not been finalised — you will define them together with Felix and Tech advisors based on your experience and what is right for the platform.
This is one of the few roles in DACH fintech where technical depth, genuine entrepreneurial ownership, and real equity participation come together.
What you own
Architecture & Infrastructure
· Design and build an event-sourced backend architecture — the structural foundation for regulatory-grade auditability under MiFID II and BaFin requirements
· Multi-tenant data architecture: one platform, many partner firms, strict data isolation and RBAC
· Batch data ingest pipeline from partner firm systems (custodian banks, PMS) — the Phase 1 data foundation
· Cloud infrastructure on AWS (Frankfurt region) — we use hyperscaler-grade tooling from day one
Workflows & AI
· Advisory workflow engine — regulated advisory processes as structured, automated flows with compliance write-back (Jahresgespräch, KYC/AML as Phase 1 scope)
· AI integration: automated meeting briefings, Gesprächsprotokoll generation, and document assembly for advisors via Gemini/RAG pipeline
· Compliance infrastructure: PII anonymisation before any LLM call, encryption at rest, consent management — structural, not bolt-on
Team & culture
· Coordinate the freelance senior full-stack engineer: architectural decisions, code quality, mutual peer review
· Technical point of contact for the product advisor and design partner advisors during pilot deployment
· Set the engineering culture from day one — we use agentic coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) as standard. We cover the cost.
What Thrivo offers
Real equity participation
Thrivo offers a VSOP participation in the Holding. Structure and terms in conversation.
Ownership from day one
As the founding engineer, you set architecture standards and engineering practices the team will carry for years. You are not executing tickets — you are building the platform.
First-class team
Direct collaboration with Felix Lobkowicz (5 consumer companies founded, one through IPO), Christopher Kraft (Perella Weinberg Partners, 50+ IWM transactions), Finn Weise (Morgan Stanley, VC) and Sebastian Henrichs (former CEO FNZ Bank Germany).
We offer a competitive base salary and a meaningful VSOP participation in the Holding. Structure and exact terms in conversation.

· 5–8+ years of backend engineering in production systems — the right profile depends on depth of architecture experience, not years alone
· Event Sourcing and CQRS in practice — you have built it, not just read about it
· Domain-Driven Design — bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events
· PostgreSQL — schema design, query optimisation, pgvector
· AWS or comparable hyperscaler — production deployment, IAM, VPC, managed services
· Experience in regulated environments — fintech, banking, or insurance
· Senior enough to make architectural decisions independently and coordinate a freelance engineer
· CET timezone — daily overlap for peer review and fast alignment is required
What interests us additionally
· Go, TypeScript, or Java — we care about architecture patterns (Event Sourcing, CQRS, DDD), not the language on your CV. Experience with Go or willingness to work in Go is a plus.
· Familiarity with MiFID II, WpIG, or FINMA regulatory requirements
· Experience with graph-based workflow engines or saga patterns
· German is a plus, not a requirement

You have proven you can build complex systems. But you are not looking for the next job at a scale-up with 200 engineers where your work disappears into a microservice pipeline. You want to set the architecture, own the platform, and know that what you build is in production and making a real difference.
An early stage does not put you off — it attracts you, because you know the most important decisions are being made now. And you understand that equity in a platform that is positioning to be the market leader in a structurally underserved segment can be worth more than the next salary band.

The Opportunity
AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate.
As AI agents become capable of executing increasingly complex workflows, enterprise buying decisions are becoming increasingly technical. Customers don't just want to hear what's possible—they want to see it working.
At Lio, we're building THE AI workforce for procurement.
As a Soltion Architect , you're not just supporting sales.
You're helping some of the world's largest enterprises gain the technical confidence to adopt AI. You'll build prototypes, lead technical workshops, solve customer challenges, and work side-by-side with our Account Executives to turn complex enterprise opportunities into successful deals.

Own the technical strategy of enterprise opportunities from first conversation to signed deal
Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and product evaluations with DAX companies and Fortune 500 customers
Build prototypes, proof of concepts, and custom extensions that demonstrate measurable business value
Design scalable solutions that integrate Lio into complex enterprise environments
Build trusted relationships with procurement leaders, IT teams, architects, and C-level stakeholders
Work closely with Product and Engineering to turn customer requirements into scalable platform capabilities
Help shape our enterprise sales strategy by combining technical expertise with commercial thinking
Your Profile

s.h: You'll thrive in this role if you
s.t:
Enjoy combining technology and customer interaction. You like building software just as much as presenting it to customers.
Have experience with APIs, SaaS platforms, cloud environments, or software development. You don't need to be a full-time engineer, but you're comfortable building and adapting technical solutions.
Take ownership. You enjoy influencing enterprise buying decisions and helping close complex technical deals.
Communicate confidently. Whether you're speaking with engineers, architects, procurement teams, or C-level executives, you know how to explain complex technology with clarity.
Thrive in fast-moving environments. You enjoy solving new challenges, learning quickly, and working across Sales, Product, and Engineering.
Are curious about AI and excited about helping enterprises adopt a new generation of software.
What's not required
You don't need experience in procurement or deep knowledge of ERP systems.
We're much more interested in technical curiosity, customer empathy, ownership, and your ability to solve complex problems than in having the perfect CV.

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and built at Y Combinator . We're bringing Silicon Valley ambition and speed to Munich while building one of Europe's leading AI companies.
From day one, you'll work on strategic enterprise opportunities with Fortune 500 companies across Europe and the US. You'll help shape how AI is adopted inside global enterprises while working closely with Account Executives, Product, Engineering, and our founders.
If you're excited about combining software, enterprise sales, and AI to help win category-defining customers, we'd love to hear from you.

Provectus is a consulting and professional services firm with a focus on AI/ML based solutions. Provectus is an AWS Premier Partner and an Anthropic partner, helping enterprise clients move from AI experimentation to AI running in production.
We are changing how we deliver. Instead of handing a client a design and waiting for someone else to build it, our engineers embed directly inside the client's team and ship the system themselves. We call this Forward Deployed delivery. Before you design anything, you spend real time with the people who do the work the system is meant to change, so the architecture reflects how the work actually happens, not how a requirements document described it.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer or Solutions Architect with deep Python and Generative AI experience who wants to work this way: deep in the code, close to the client, and directly accountable for whether the system gets used. Direct client communication sits at the center of this role. Prior presales experience is a strong plus.

Embed with the client team for the length of the engagement, working inside their environment rather than alongside it from a distance
Spend time with the people who do the job the system is meant to change before you design anything, so the architecture is grounded in how the work actually happens
Write clean, production grade Python across AI integrations, backend services, and RESTful APIs (Flask, Django, or FastAPI)
Design, build, and optimize RAG systems and agentic AI solutions running in production, not demos or notebooks

Own the technical direction of the engagement from discovery through delivery

Support presales activities where relevant, including discovery calls, technical proposals, scoping, and client facing demos
Lead architecture reviews, produce technical design documents, and contribute to standards across the Python practice
Feed what you learn back into Provectus 's blueprint library, so the next engagement starts further ahead
Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, and share knowledge across the team

ServiceNow is seeking Enterprise Architects to join our UK&I Team. Influence and impact at multiple levels within a customer account (Enterprise Architects, Domain Architects, Directors, VPs, and CXOs) and maintain these relationships throughout their customer journey.
